At antipodal separation its value is a−B, whereas for any other admissible placement a 2x2 shifted symmetric block has determinant 2t^2(B^2−C^2)<0. Rationalization yields the strictly positive exact loss; Taylor expansion gives sharp coefficients. Both symbolic and independent finite numerical checks executed successfully from actual CHECK.py, not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Two equal fixed-duration observation arcs are a natural sensor-allocation geometry for a low-pass periodic signal. The theorem gives the complete sharp reconstruction-noise bound for every observation fraction, proves that antipodal placement is the sole optimal design, quantifies placement tolerance with a sharp quadratic law, and shows a nontrivial beta^-2 advantage over concentrating observations in one interval. It resolves a motivated full continuous design family rather than an arbitrary isolated numerical case.
